visual_review.assessment: Six complete crimson dragon-knight poses preserve screen-left long sword, screen-right pointed shield, horned helmet and cape. Knee and boot changes are visible, but the same leading leg dominates and opposite-leg leadership remains unclear. One bounded correction did not clearly improve it; original kept.
